pairs: tempore illo vinea erat Naboth Jezrahelitæ,
in that time, there was a vineyard of Naboth, the Jezreelite,
beside the palace of Ahab, the king of Samaria.
Locutus est ergo Achab ad Naboth,
Therefore, Ahab spoke to Naboth, saying:
“Give your vineyard to me, so that I may make for myself a garden of herbs.
For it is nearby and is beside my house.
And I will give to you,
in place of it, a better vineyard.
daboque tibi pro ea vineam meliorem,
Or if you consider it to be more convenient for you,
aut si commodius tibi putas, argenti pretium,
I will give you the price in silver,
“May the Lord be gracious to me,
ne dem hæreditatem patrum meorum tibi.
lest I give to you the inheritance of my fathers.”
Venit ergo Achab in domum suam indignans,
Then Ahab went into his house,
et frendens super verbo quod locutus fuerat ad eum Naboth Jezrahelites,
angry and gnashing his teeth over the word that Naboth, the Jezreelite, had spoken to him,
Non dabo tibi hæreditatem patrum meorum.
“I will not give you the inheritance of my fathers.”
Et projiciens se in lectulum suum,
And casting himself on his bed,
he turned away his face to the wall,
and he would not eat bread.
Ingressa est autem ad eum Jezabel uxor sua,
Then Jezebel, his wife, entered to him,
by which your soul has been saddened?
And why do you not eat bread?”
dabo tibi vineam meliorem pro ea.
I will give to you a better vineyard,
And he said, ‘I will not give my vineyard to you.’”
Dixit ergo ad eum Jezabel uxor ejus:
Then Jezebel, his wife, said to him:
et bene regis regnum Israël. Surge,
and you rule well in the kingdom of Israel.
ego dabo tibi vineam Naboth Jezrahelitæ.
I will give the vineyard of Naboth, the Jezreelite, to you.”
Scripsit itaque litteras ex nomine Achab,
she wrote letters in the name of Ahab,
and she sealed these with his ring.
And she sent to those greater by birth,
and to the nobles who were in his city
And this was the judgment of the letters:
et sedere facite Naboth inter primos populi:
and cause Naboth to sit among the first rulers of the people.
et submittite duos viros filios Belial contra eum,
And send out two men, sons of Belial, against him.
And let them speak the false testimony:
Fecerunt ergo cives ejus majores natu et optimates,
qui habitabant cum eo in urbe,
those greater by birth and the nobles who were living with him in the city,
did just as Jezebel had instructed them,
et sicut scriptum erat in litteris quas miserat ad eos:
and just as it was written in the letters that she had sent to them.
et sedere fecerunt Naboth inter primos populi.
and they caused Naboth to sit among the first rulers of the people.
Et adductis duobus viris filiis diaboli,
And bringing forward two men, sons of the devil,
they caused them to sit opposite him.
dixerunt contra eum testimonium coram multitudine:
spoke testimony against him before the multitude:
quam ob rem eduxerunt eum extra civitatem,
For this reason, they led him away, beyond the city,
and they put him to death by stoning.
cum audisset Jezabel lapidatum Naboth et mortuum,
when Jezebel had heard that Naboth was stoned and was dead,
“Rise up and take possession of the vineyard of Naboth,
who was not willing to acquiesce to you,
and to give it to you in exchange for money.
And when Ahab had heard this,
surrexit, et descendebat in vineam Naboth Jezrahelitæ,
he rose up and descended to the vineyard of Naboth, the Jezreelite,
so that he might take possession of it.
Factus est igitur sermo Domini ad Eliam Thesbiten,
Then the word of the Lord came to Elijah, the Tishbite,
et descende in occursum Achab regis Israël,
and descend to meet Ahab, the king of Israel,
he is descending to the vineyard of Naboth,
so that he may take possession of it.
And you shall speak to him,
Moreover you have also taken possession.’
in quo linxerunt canes sanguinem Naboth,
where the dogs have licked the blood of Naboth,
they shall also lick your blood.’”
“Have you discovered me to be your enemy?”
“I have discovered you to have been sold,
ut faceres malum in conspectu Domini.
so that you would do evil in the sight of the Lord:
Ecce ego inducam super te malum,
‘Behold, I will lead evil over you.
And I will cut down your posterity.
et interficiam de Achab mingentem ad parietem,
And I will put to death of Ahab whatever urinates against a wall,
et clausum et ultimum in Israël.
and whatever is lame, and whatever is last in Israel.
Et dabo domum tuam sicut domum Jeroboam filii Nabat,
And I will cause your house to be like the house of Jeroboam, the son of Nebat,
et sicut domum Baasa filii Ahia:
and like the house of Baasha, the son of Ahijah.
quia egisti ut me ad iracundiam provocares,
For you have acted so that you provoked me to anger,
and so that you caused Israel to sin.’
et de Jezabel locutus est Dominus,
Canes comedent Jezabel in agro Jezrahel.
‘The dogs shall consume Jezebel in the field of Jezreel.
Si mortuus fuerit Achab in civitate,
If Ahab will have died in the city,
si autem mortuus fuerit in agro,
But if he will have died in the field,
the birds of the air will consume him.’”
Igitur non fuit alter talis sicut Achab,
And so, there was no other person similar to Ahab,
qui venundatus est ut faceret malum in conspectu Domini:
who was sold so that he did evil in the sight of the Lord.
concitavit enim eum Jezabel uxor sua,
For his wife, Jezebel, urged him on.
in tantum ut sequeretur idola quæ fecerant Amorrhæi,
so much so that he followed the idols that the Amorites had made,
quos consumpsit Dominus a facie filiorum Israël.
whom the Lord consumed before the face of the sons of Israel.
Itaque cum audisset Achab sermones istos,
Then, when Ahab had heard these words,
and he put haircloth on his body,
and he fasted, and he slept in sackcloth,
and he walked with his head downcast.
Et factus est sermo Domini ad Eliam Thesbiten,
And the word of the Lord came to Elijah, the Tishbite,
Nonne vidisti humiliatum Achab coram me?
“Have you not seen how Ahab has humbled himself before me?
quia igitur humiliatus est mei causa,
Therefore, since he has humbled himself because of me,
non inducam malum in diebus ejus,
I will not lead in the evil during his days. Instead,
sed in diebus filii sui inferam malum domui ejus.
during the days of his son, I will bring in the evil to his house.”
